footnotes.227900: - Interpreted as the Preserved Slate or possibly the Qur’ān.

footnotes.227901: - The house of worship for the angels in the seventh heaven, comparable to the Kaʿbah on earth.

5.text: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high

6.text: And [by] the sea set on fire,<sup foot_note="227902">1</sup>

footnotes.227902: - On the Day of Resurrection.  Or "the sea which has overflowed."

7.text: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

8.text: Of it there is no preventer.

9.text: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

10.text: And the mountains will pass on, departing<sup foot_note="227903">1</sup> -

footnotes.227903: - Becoming dust and moving as clouds.

11.text: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

12.text: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

13.text: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

14.text: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

15.text: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

16.text: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

17.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

18.text: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

19.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

20.text: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

21.text: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.<sup foot_note="227904">1</sup> Every person, for what he earned, is retained.<sup foot_note="227905">2</sup>

footnotes.227905: i.e., subject or held responsible.  Literally, "a hostage."

22.text: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

23.text: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

24.text: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

25.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

26.text: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

27.text: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

28.text: Indeed, we used to supplicate<sup foot_note="227906">1</sup> Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

29.text: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

30.text: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?<sup foot_note="227907">1</sup>

footnotes.227907: - i.e., some accident or inevitable death.

31.text: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

32.text: Or do their minds<sup foot_note="227908">1</sup> command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

footnotes.227908: - In this expression is also a subtle allusion to the leaders of the Quraysh, who considered themselves to be great minds.

33.text: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

34.text: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

35.text: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

36.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

37.text: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

38.text: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

39.text: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

40.text: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

41.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

42.text: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

43.text: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

44.text: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,<sup foot_note="227909">1</sup> they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

footnotes.227909: - Marking the onset of Allāh's punishment, as they had requested.

45.text: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

46.text: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

47.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment<sup foot_note="227910">1</sup> before that, but most of them do not know.

footnotes.227910: - If not in this world, in the grave.

48.text: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

49.text: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
